Subject: SIG questionnaire — remaining items and timing

Hi Stephanie / Sean,

Thanks again for the initial pass on the SIG. Procurement has set a hard internal cut: we need final answers and supporting artifacts by end of day 2027-09-22 to make our security review for the pilot cohort. I reviewed the spreadsheet you sent — there are ~18 remaining open questions and two gating artifacts listed (SOC 2 report + network diagram).

Can you: 1) confirm an ETA for the remaining Qs, 2) confirm whether you can provide a copy of the 2027 SOC 2 report and a network diagram, and 3) let me know if you can accept phased delivery (answers first, artifacts second) if that helps us hit the deadline?

Attached: SIG-questions-v2.xlsx (we highlighted the must-have items).

If it's easier, happy to lock in a 30-min checkpoint next week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, IT & Security
ClearPath Health
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire — remaining items and timing

Daniel — thanks for the clarity and the highlighted sheet. Short answer: yes, we can support a phased delivery; that will help us move faster on the answers while we pull artifact-level evidence.

Proposed plan (internal owners noted):
- Sep 16 EOD: deliver completed answers to the 18 open SIG items (owner: Sean).
- Sep 20 EOD: provide SOC 2 cert copy + network diagram + any KMS/HSM evidence (owner: Hannah).
- Sep 22: final handoff & sign-off (if any follow-ups remain).

Notes/assumptions:
- The network diagram we provide is redacted for org-internal IPs; if you need a full unredacted diagram we will need an NDA and justification (let us know).
- SOC 2: we will attach our 2027 Type II certificate and the auditor letter; if your procurement needs the full report, we can arrange a more formal exchange (DocuSign or secure S3 link).

If you prefer a checkpoint call, I'm available Thu Sep 16 at 11am PT. Otherwise we'll push the partial package on the 16th and the artifacts on the 20th.

Thanks — we'll prioritize this.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
